# card init PATH creates PATH/.cardamom without requiring prior discovery.
mkdir init-project
exec card init init-project --prefix init-
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/init.txt
exists init-project/.cardamom/board.sqlite3
cmp init-project/.cardamom/config.yaml $WORK/golden/config.yaml

-- golden/init.txt --
initialized init-project/.cardamom
Automatic local exclusion failed. Add these patterns to .gitignore:
.cardamom/board.sqlite3
.cardamom/board.sqlite3-shm
.cardamom/board.sqlite3-wal
.cardamom/blobs/
-- golden/config.yaml --
